website-audited.eventDescription: One business whose website was fetched and audited, including sites found broken. Sites that block automated checks are free.

lead-no-website.eventDescription: One business with no website of its own (none, only a social or listing page, or a shut-down site builder). Scored without fetching anything.

contacts-extracted.eventDescription: A public business email, phone number or WhatsApp link found on the site. Only when contact extraction is on and something was found.
